title: Deliverance from Serpentine Spirits
subtitle: Warfare and Prophetic Declarations · Part 1
attribution: Pastor Kiky Ocansey · L137 Deliverance Ministry
tagline: L137 — Luke 1:37 · For with God nothing shall be impossible
short_description: A biblical deliverance teaching by Pastor Kiky Ocansey on recognising, resisting, and casting out serpentine spirits — the ancient serpent and his works — through repentance, the blood of Jesus, the fire of the Holy Ghost, and the authority given to every believer to tread upon serpents and scorpions.

scripture_groups.note: The service opens in thanksgiving. God is our shield, our glory, and the lifter of our head; His mercy is why we are not consumed.
Every sin opens a door to a spirit; forgiveness closes that door and lets a clean heart and a right spirit come in.
The Spirit of God hovers over the deep places of your life; He is the Comforter and Helper who must lead the deliverance.
The serpent is subtle and deceptive; his works are unseen and long-lasting, but God has put enmity between his seed and hers.

scripture_groups.topic: The Serpent Cast Out — the Dragon of Revelation
scripture_groups.note: The great dragon, that old serpent, was cast out of heaven to the earth. He is after the destiny you carry, but he is overcome by the blood of the Lamb and the word of our testimony.
Jesus gives the believer power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy.
The thief comes to steal, kill and destroy; when the hedge of protection is broken, the serpent bites. He attacks in the wilderness of your life.
Resist the devil and he will flee. Our weapons are mighty through God to pull down strongholds; our faith is the victory.

scripture_groups.topic: The Blood, the Brass Serpent & Deliverance
scripture_groups.note: The blood of Jesus speaks better things; as Israel looked on the brass serpent and lived, we look to Christ lifted up. The viper is shaken into the fire, and the bound is loosed.
Whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

memory_verses.note: The believer's authority: power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy.
The overcoming weapon: the blood of the Lamb and the word of our testimony.
The pattern of deliverance: submit to God, resist the devil, and he will flee.
The lifted-up remedy: look to the fiery serpent on the pole — a picture of Christ lifted up — and live.
The ancient promise: the Seed of the woman shall bruise the serpent's head.

modules.title: Setting the Atmosphere: Thanksgiving & the Covering
teaching: Every L137 deliverance begins by handing the meeting into the hands of the Lord — soaking the room in the blood of Jesus, asking the angels of the Lord to surround us, and declaring that no weapon formed against us shall prosper.

Pastor Kiky opens with thanksgiving, because we do not approach deliverance as beggars but as children who remember what God has already done. He is our shield, our glory, and the lifter of our head. We laid down and slept, and we awoke, because the Lord sustained us.

It is of the Lord’s mercy that we are not consumed. When we encounter the mercy of God, we walk in dimensions beyond our imagination — the same mercy that took Joseph out of prison and made him a prime minister. Thanksgiving invites the presence of the Lord before the warfare begins.
reflection: What has God done for me this week that I have not thanked Him for?
How does remembering God as my shield change the way I go into spiritual warfare?
Where do I need to trade fear of “ten thousands” for confidence in God’s covering?
application: Begin every prayer time this week with five minutes of thanksgiving before you ask for anything.
Write down three specific mercies of God from the past seven days.

modules.title: Repentance, Forgiveness & Inviting the Holy Spirit
teaching: Pastor Kiky teaches that every sin brings about a spirit that dwells with you. When you ask forgiveness of sins, you open the door of your heart and soul so that every wicked spirit that unforgiveness and sin brought in is able to flee from you.

So we get rid of all bitterness, rage, and anger — they are all spirits — and we ask God to create in us a clean heart and renew a right spirit within us. The right spirit is the favour, the miracle, the signs and wonders you are about to ask the Lord for.

Before any signs and wonders, we invite the Holy Ghost to lead us. As in the beginning the Spirit of God hovered over the face of the deep, so the Holy Spirit hovers over the deep, dark, formless places of your life, waiting to be invited to bring order, clarity, and deliverance. Jesus called Him the Comforter and Helper who will not come until we welcome Him.
reflection: Is there any unforgiveness I am holding that is keeping a door open in my life?
What “formless and void” area of my life needs the Holy Spirit to hover and bring order?
Have I truly invited the Holy Spirit to lead — or am I trying to fight in my own strength?
application: Make a written list of anyone you need to forgive, and release each one aloud in prayer.
Each morning this week, invite the Holy Spirit to lead your day before you do anything else.

modules.title: What Serpentine Spirits Are & How You Come in Contact
teaching: In the realm of the spirit, the devil appears in the form of a serpent. Serpentine spirits are terrible demons. Some families worship serpents, keep images or jewellery bearing serpent shapes, or have shrines and altars dedicated to serpent worship — and this is passed down the bloodline. The serpent is not interested in the flesh; when covenants are made, it looks at the blood, at the bloodline.

Contact comes many ways: through inherited family worship and ancestral covenants; through sexual encounters and close friendships with people from such backgrounds; through unbelievers who carry these spirits; through witch doctors, sorcerers, occultists, diviners, psychics, and false “marine-powered prophets” who summon these spirits against a person’s progress, marriage, and destiny.

What some people call a spirit spouse is a serpent spirit — a serpent appearing in human form, having relations in a dream. These spirits stand behind spirit husbands and spirit wives, behind repeated rising and falling, demonic nightmares, and blocked fruitfulness. They also work through counterfeit voices in the mind that whisper deception, condemnation, and even self-harm. The teaching is sober: this is real, but there is a way out through deliverance and prayer by the power of the Holy Ghost.
reflection: Are there patterns in my family line — marriages breaking, dream torment, chronic lack — that point to a foundational stronghold?
How does knowing the serpent targets the bloodline change how I pray for my children and generation?
What counterfeit “voices” have I mistaken for my own thoughts?
application: Ask the Holy Spirit to show you any inherited covenant that needs to be renounced.
Refuse and rebuke every voice of condemnation or self-harm the moment it comes — replace it with Scripture.

modules.title: The Serpent Is the Devil — and He Is Cast Down
teaching: Who are these serpent powers? The serpent is the devil himself. Revelation 12:9 calls him “that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world.” God cast him out of heaven so that he would not destroy the angels and everything in the heavens — and his polluted angels were cast out with him.

Because the serpent is a satanic power, Jesus gives us authority in Luke 10:19 to tread upon serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy. The name of Jesus is above every name, including the name of any serpent or idol.

So any inkling, suspicion, or action of this spirit in your life must be cast out. Do not let it feel comfortable. If you allow it to remain, it will destroy your body, bring shame, poverty, accidents, and take you to the lowest part of your life. What God cast out of heaven, you have authority to cast out of your life.
reflection: Do I really believe the authority Jesus has given me is greater than any serpent power?
Where have I allowed something to “get comfortable” that I should have cast out?
What does it mean that whatever I bind on earth is bound in heaven?
application: Speak Luke 10:19 aloud daily as a declaration of your authority.
Identify one thing you have tolerated too long, and bind and cast it out in prayer.

modules.title: The Serpent as Deceiver — Poison, Subtlety & the Wilderness
teaching: The serpent is a deceiver. It injects poison into your vessel and deceives you through evil wisdom and subtlety. It tells the proud, the sleeping-around, and the addicted that they are “fine” and “absolutely okay,” silencing conviction so the bondage can deepen.

It launches its attacks especially at your rising. Just as it came to tempt Jesus at the end of His forty days in the wilderness (Luke 4), it meets you in the wilderness of your life — when you have gone through much and are weary — whispering that a drink, a substance, or a compromise will make you feel okay and help you forget your troubles.

It is subtle, slow, and clever — wise as a serpent, Matthew 10:16 says of its craft. It can drive kleptomania, chronic smoking, and hidden compulsions, and it pretends to leave during deliverance only to manifest again later. These spirits hide in the dark places where the light of God’s word is absent, monitor a life, and then attack.
reflection: In what area has the serpent told me “you’re fine” when God is calling me to repent?
What “wilderness season” am I in where I am tempted to self-medicate rather than pray?
Where is the light of God’s word absent in my daily life, giving darkness a place to hide?
application: Bring one hidden compromise into the light this week — confess it and invite accountability.
Replace one numbing habit with a fixed time in the Word and prayer.

modules.title: Broken Hedges, Bites & the Diseases of the Enemy
teaching: Ecclesiastes 10:8 warns: “whoso breaketh an hedge, a serpent shall bite him.” Divine protection is a covenant right of every genuine child of God, but the serpent first deceives you out of your place of power and protection so he can enter to destroy you. Stepping out of your boundaries — abandoning prayer, the Word, church, and godly fellowship — breaks the hedge.

That is why the serpent attacks your prayer life, your Bible reading, your attendance, and the people praying for you — these are your protective shield. Friendship with the world is enmity with God (James 4:4); keeping unsaved intimate friends can introduce drinking, smoking, and immorality that covenant you to spirits you never chose.

The bite of the serpent brings spiritual sickness, affliction, and terminal illness through evil deposits and plantations — sometimes through eating, drinking, or sexual relations in a dream. And when a believer tests, questions, or judges God, 1 Corinthians 10:9 shows that even Israel was destroyed of serpents. God’s promise, though, is to take away all sickness and lay the diseases of the enemy upon those who hate us (Deuteronomy 7:15).
reflection: Which part of my hedge — prayer, the Word, fellowship, church — has the enemy weakened?
Are there friendships that are pulling me toward the world rather than toward God?
Have I been tempting or judging God instead of trusting Him in a hard season?
application: Rebuild one “hedge” this week: recommit to a daily prayer time, Scripture reading, or church attendance.
Prayerfully evaluate your closest friendships and set godly boundaries where needed.

modules.title: Symptoms of Serpentine Attack
teaching: Pastor Kiky lists the fingerprints of a serpentine attack so you can recognise what you are fighting: rising and falling in life, demotion “from riches to rags” and “grace to grass,” being kept at the tail and not the head, living below your standard and expectation.

Other signs: constant confusion and lack of focus, no clear decisions or direction, draining every conversation, chronic lateness that makes you miss goodness and favour, repeated errors and mistakes, refusing sound advice, murmuring and complaining, helpers who disappear and become uncooperative, and a stubborn backwardness where juniors overtake you and life seems stuck in one place.

There are also strange voices — telling you that you are ugly, unworthy, not okay — and speaking to invisible things. All of this is the thief who comes to steal, kill, and destroy (John 10:10). But the Lord says you should have victory, and He wants to touch you with deliverance.
reflection: Which of these symptoms do I recognise in my own life or family?
Where has confusion or chronic lateness been costing me God’s goodness?
What lies have strange voices spoken over my identity that I need to renounce?
application: Write down the recurring patterns you recognise and bring each one to God in the deliverance prayers.
Counter every identity lie with what God’s Word says about you.

modules.title: The Way Out — Fire, the Blood & the Brass Serpent
teaching: The way out is deliverance and prayer by the power of the Holy Ghost. Repent from and deal with sin, stop murmuring against God and His constituted authority, surrender your life to Christ, and deal with fear and unbelief. Get filled with the Holy Ghost — the serpent cannot stand the fire of the Holy Ghost. When Paul stirred the fire, the viper came out (Acts 28:3); when the fire starts in your life, the viper shows its neck and comes out.

Exercise your spiritual authority and do not wait until the attack gets worse. The blood of Jesus is the only antidote for every serpent’s bite and poison. As Moses lifted the fiery serpent of brass on a pole and everyone who looked lived (Numbers 21:8–9), so we look to Christ lifted up, barricade our lives with His blood, and trust God in faith.

The deliverance session uses communion (the blood) and cleansing water only through Christ’s finished work, ending with a sevenfold breathing exercise to breathe in the Holy Ghost and breathe out every deposit — then filling the swept house with the Holy Ghost so nothing can return, and sealing with anointing oil and thanksgiving.
reflection: Am I waiting for the attack to get worse, or exercising my authority now?
How am I keeping the “fire” of the Holy Ghost burning so the viper cannot rest?
Do I use the blood of Jesus once and relax — or continually, as my daily weapon?
application: Take communion in faith through Christ’s finished work as part of your deliverance.
Make pleading the blood of Jesus a daily habit, not a one-time act.

modules.title: The War in Heaven — Revelation 12 & the Destiny You Carry
teaching: Pastor Kiky closes Part 1 in Revelation 12. The woman clothed with the sun, crowned with twelve stars, travailing to give birth, represents you — carrying a destiny, struggling to bring forth something great: a home, a career, a marriage, a generation.

The great red dragon — that old serpent — stands before the woman to devour her child as soon as it is born. The dragon is after your life and after what you carry to deliver. He attacks your health, your marriage, your finances, your academics, your mind, to keep your glory from manifesting. Sometimes God hides your destiny for a season, moves you to another place, and protects it until the appointed time.

But the war was already won. The dragon and his angels lost their place in heaven; the accuser of the brethren is cast down. And we overcome him “by the blood of the Lamb, and by the word of their testimony; and they loved not their lives unto the death” (Revelation 12:11). God did not leave us to fight this alone — He gave us the weapons. Part 2 continues on Saturday.
reflection: What is the destiny — the “child” — God has placed in me that the enemy is trying to devour?
Can I trust God to hide and protect my destiny until the appointed time?
How will I use the two weapons of Revelation 12:11 — the blood and my testimony — this week?
application: Meditate on Revelation 12 and thank God that the accuser is already cast down.
Speak your testimony aloud — declare what God has done and will do — as a weapon of overcoming.

declarations.title: Taking Authority
lines: In the name of Jesus Christ, I bind every spirit of rebellion, pride and arrogance.
I bind and I rebuke any serpent that would try to deceive in my life.
By the power of the Holy Ghost, I bind any serpent in this house, in my vessel, and in my environment right now.
I release the rod of God to swallow up every serpent that would rise up against me.

declarations.title: Breaking Ancestral & Serpentine Covenants
lines: Blood of Jesus, buy me back from every serpent spirit to which I have been sold.
Every ancestral debt collector forcing me to pay what I did not buy — I claim the blood of Jesus against you.
Every sin in my foundation, every serpent in my blood — die by the fire of the Holy Ghost.
Any covenant I have made, knowingly or unknowingly, with any satanic power — I break it now in the name of Jesus.
I disconnect myself and I disconnect my generation from every serpent covenant in my family, in the name of Jesus.

declarations.title: Casting Out the Serpent
lines: Every serpent hiding in my body, I command you to come out now in the name of Jesus Christ.
Every sea serpent, every flying serpent, every cobra-like serpent, every python — come out of my life right now.
According to Isaiah 27:1, I bind and I rebuke every lying serpent that would attack my life.
I neutralize every serpent’s defilement, pollution and contamination with the blood of Jesus.
Any man or woman turning into a serpent to frustrate the will of God in my life — by the blood of Jesus, come out of my life.

declarations.title: Releasing Poison & Receiving Deliverance
lines: Anything I ate in the dream, anything I drank in the dream, any serpent that bit me in the dream — release your poisons of affliction now.
As I drink the blood of Jesus, I vomit you out, I cough you out, I cast you out, you deposits of the serpent.
As I drink the blood of Jesus, I establish the new covenant of God in my life.
I receive my deliverance right now, in the name of Jesus.

declarations.title: Sealing, Protection & Freedom
lines: Lord Jesus, protect me from every fiery serpent that will come against me.
By the power of the Holy Ghost, I command the power to tread on serpents and scorpions to come upon me now.
In the power and authority of our Lord Jesus Christ, I crush the serpent’s head.
As I anoint myself with this oil, I rejoice that Christ has triumphed over sin and death in my life.
I am free from every evil spirit, in the name of Jesus. I overcome the serpent by the word of my testimony. I am free.

prayer_points.title: Repentance
lines: Father, forgive me of every sin I have committed knowingly and unknowingly, in the name of Jesus.
Lord, cleanse me and wash me with the precious blood of Jesus Christ of Nazareth.
Purge me from every act of sin, every attitude, every bitterness, every anger, and every rage that has brought sin into my life.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me (Psalm 51:10).

prayer_points.title: Forgiveness
lines: Lord, forgive me for any way that I have been upset, bitter, rough, or backbiting.
Take away every negative spirit and every spirit that sin has brought into my soul, and leave me whole again.
I let go of all bitterness, wrath, anger, and evil speaking, and I choose to be kind and tenderhearted, forgiving as Christ forgave me (Ephesians 4:31–32).

prayer_points.title: Renunciation
lines: I renounce every agreement, knowingly or unknowingly, with any serpent spirit or idol.
I renounce every friendship, relationship, and encounter that covenanted me to serpentine spirits.
I renounce every voice of the serpent that has spoken deception, condemnation, or self-harm into my mind.

prayer_points.title: Breaking Covenants
lines: Any covenant I have made, knowingly or unknowingly, with any satanic power — leave my body right now, in the name of Jesus. I break it, I break it.
Blood of Jesus, buy me back from every serpent spirit to which I have been sold.
Every ancestral debt collector forcing me to pay what I did not buy — I claim the blood of Jesus.
I disconnect myself and my generation from every serpent covenant in my family, in the name of Jesus.

prayer_points.title: Breaking Altars
lines: Every serpent worship and every altar dedicated to serpents in my family line, I rebuke you and I detach myself and my household from you.
Powers calling my name from an altar — I silence you by the blood of Jesus.
Serpentine powers at my bed-place attacking my life and my destiny — come out now in the name of Jesus.

prayer_points.title: Deliverance
lines: Every serpent hiding in my body, I command you to come out now, in the name of Jesus Christ.
Every sea serpent, flying serpent, cobra-like serpent, and python — come out of my life right now.
Every viper hiding in my body — in my stomach, my head, my ears, my limbs — I shake you off and cast you out, in the name of Jesus (Acts 28:3).
Destroy the power behind every serpent troubling my life; every evil spirit monitoring my life, die now in the name of Jesus.
Let every deposit of the serpent come out by every opening of my body, by the power of the Holy Ghost.

prayer_points.title: Healing
lines: Let this water wash away every venom, every poison, and every affliction in my body, in the name of Jesus.
Any disease hidden in my body that has not been located — any cancer, any kidney problem, any affliction — I command it out by the power of the Holy Ghost.
I am healed by the stripes of Jesus Christ. I receive life in my brain, my system, my veins, and in every part of my body.
Let healing enter me now, in the name of Jesus.

prayer_points.title: Restoration
lines: By the blood of Jesus, I restore to my life all that has been stolen (John 10:10).
Every blessing the serpent has swallowed — I recover it now, in the name of Jesus.
Let confusion give way to clarity, delay give way to divine timing, and weakness give way to supernatural strength.

prayer_points.title: Thanksgiving
lines: Thank You, Lord, for my deliverance tonight; I give You all the glory, for my victory is found in Jesus Christ alone.
I thank You for Your faithfulness, Your goodness, and Your mercy over my family and my loved ones.
I bless the Lord and forget not all His benefits (Psalm 103:2).

prayer_points.title: Protection
lines: Lord Jesus, protect me from every fiery serpent that will come against me.
Surround my home, my body, and my household with Your angels, and let no weapon formed against me prosper.
By the power of the Holy Ghost, I command the power to tread on serpents and scorpions to come upon me now (Luke 10:19).
As I go to sleep, let Your angels encamp around me and give me sound sleep, in the name of Jesus.

prayer_points.title: Sealing Prayers
lines: As I drink the blood of Jesus, I establish the new covenant of God in my life (Hebrews 12:24).
As I anoint myself with this oil, I rejoice that Christ has triumphed over sin and death in my life.
I fill my vessel with the Holy Ghost from the crown of my head to the soles of my feet, so that nothing cast out can return.
Whatever left my body, leave permanently; give me life, and give it to me more abundantly. I seal my deliverance, in the name of Jesus.

bible_characters.name: Eve
bible_characters.note: The serpent was more subtle than any beast and deceived Eve with a whispered doubt, “Yea, hath God said?” Principle: serpentine spirits attack through counterfeit voices and subtle deception — guard your mind and test every voice against God’s word.

bible_characters.name: Moses
bible_characters.note: God told Moses to make a fiery serpent of brass and set it on a pole; all who looked upon it lived. Principle: a picture of Christ lifted up — look to Him for healing from every serpent’s bite.

bible_characters.name: Joseph
bible_characters.note: Pastor Kiky notes that when Joseph encountered God’s mercy, it took him out of prison and made him a prime minister. Principle: the mercy of God lifts us into dimensions beyond our imagination, even out of the pit.

bible_characters.name: Jesus in the Wilderness
bible_characters.note: After forty days of fasting, the tempter came to divert Jesus’ destiny. Principle: the serpent attacks at your rising and in your wilderness — answer, as Jesus did, with the Word.

bible_characters.name: Paul on Melita
bible_characters.note: As Paul laid sticks on the fire, a viper came out of the heat and fastened on his hand, but he shook it off into the fire and felt no harm. Principle: the fire of the Holy Ghost forces the hidden viper to manifest so it can be cast off.

bible_characters.name: Michael the Archangel
bible_characters.note: Michael and his angels fought the dragon in heaven and prevailed; the dragon lost his place. Principle: the war against the serpent is already won in heaven — we enforce the victory on earth.

bible_characters.name: Lazarus
bible_characters.note: Lazarus came forth bound hand and foot, and Jesus said, “Loose him, and let him go.” Principle: deliverance is the loosing of one whom Christ has already called to life.

quiz.q: According to Revelation 12:9, who is “that old serpent”?
options: The Devil and Satan, who deceiveth the whole world

quiz.q: In Luke 10:19, what power does Jesus give the believer?
options: Power to tread on serpents and scorpions and over all the power of the enemy

quiz.q: According to Revelation 12:11, how is the serpent overcome?
options: By the blood of the Lamb and the word of our testimony

quiz.q: In Ecclesiastes 10:8, what happens to the one who breaks a hedge?
What did Moses lift up on a pole so the bitten could look and live (Numbers 21:8–9)?
According to the teaching, why can’t the serpent stay when the fire of the Holy Ghost comes (Acts 28:3)?
options: The viper manifests and must come out, as it did from Paul’s fire
Fire has no effect on spirits

quiz.q: What is the biblical pattern of deliverance in James 4:7?
options: Submit to God, resist the devil, and he will flee

quiz.q: In Pastor Kiky’s teaching on Revelation 12, what does the woman travailing to give birth represent?
options: You — carrying a God-given destiny the dragon wants to devour

covering_prayer: We commit this room into the hands of the Lord. We soak this room in the blood of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. We ask the angels of the Lord to surround this room and our prayers. By the power of the Holy Ghost we declare that no weapon formed against us in this room will prosper. May the Lord silence every voice of the enemy and establish His lordship over our prayers, our deliverance, and over tonight. May chains be broken and yokes be destroyed, in the mighty name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Amen.
salvation_prayer: Lord Jesus, I repent of my sins and surrender my life. Wash me clean. I believe that Jesus Christ is the Son of God, that He died on a cross for all my sins, and rose again on the third day for my victory. I believe it in my heart and make confession with my mouth that Jesus is my Saviour and Lord. I receive eternal life in Jesus’ name. Amen.
communion_prayer: We overcome the enemy by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of our testimony. As we take the blood of Jesus, let it enter our bodies and our veins; let the blood of Jesus speak better things in our bloodline and mediate against every covenant carried in our blood. Let every deposit of the serpent come out by every opening of the body, in the name of Jesus.
cleansing_water_prayer: This water is for cleansing by the power of the Holy Ghost. Let this water wash away every venom, every poison, and every contamination of the serpent spirit from head to toe. Let it enter every hiding place of the demonic and wash it out of the body system. As we drink this water, water represents life — we receive the life Christ gives, and have it more abundantly, in the name of Jesus.
breathing_exercise: Breathe in the Holy Ghost and hold it; let the Holy Spirit fill you from the crown of your head to the soles of your feet. As you breathe out, let the Holy Spirit arrest every serpent spirit and cast out every deposit it left behind. Repeat seven times — seven speaks of the perfection of the Lord — then fill the swept and clean house with the Holy Ghost so that nothing cast out can return.
